newsitem.title: GERMANY: Vereinsbank - 9-mo trade profit below expectations.
newsitem.headline: Vereinsbank - 9-mo trade profit below expectations.

text.p: Bayerische Vereinsbank AG said on Friday that its own account trading earnings had been below expectation in the third quarter of 1996 because its subsidiary Vereins und West-Bank AG earned significantly less than in the year-earlier period.
"Vereins und West-Bank was not on the right side in its assessment of interest rates in the third quarter," said Vereinsbank chairman Albrecht Schmidt in a speech prepared for a news conference.
BayernVerein group own account trading profit totalled 189.8 million marks in the first nine months, below the level of 191.8 million marks earned after just six months.

Schmidt said Vereins und West Bank, its Hamburg subsidiary, had made strong contributions to own-acount trade profit in previous years and that its other operating profits had developed well this year.
